{{Short description|British mathematician}}
'''Frank H. Berkshire''' is a British mathematician, an expert on [[fluid dynamics]], [[biomechanics]], and the [[Gambling mathematics|mathematics of gambling]].<ref>{{cite book|last=Amen|first=Saeed|doi=10.1057/9781137399533|quote=Dr. Frank Berkshire from Imperial College has researched among other things the mathematics of gambling|page=29|publisher=Palgrave Macmillan|title=Trading Thalesians: What the Ancient World Can Teach Us About Trading Today|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=YxxHBQAAQBAJ&pg=PT29|year=2014|isbn=978-1-349-48578-9}}</ref> He is a coauthor of the textbook ''[[Classical Mechanics (Kibble and Berkshire book)|Classical Mechanics]]''.<ref name=isenberg/><ref name=solomon/>

==Education and career==
Berkshire is an alumnus of [[St John's College, Cambridge]].<ref name=tf/> He joined the faculty in the department of mathematics at [[Imperial College London]] in 1967. There he became a senior lecturer, director of undergraduate studies since 1987, and teaching fellow in 1996.<ref name=tf>{{cite news|newspaper=IC Reporter|url=https://www.imperial.ac.uk/publications/reporterarchive/0036/news06.htm|publisher=Imperial College London|volume=36|date=December 1996|title=Team effort wins teaching fellowship for Maths lecturer}}</ref>

In 2000, he won Imperial College's Rector's Medal for Outstanding Contribution to Teaching Excellence.<ref>{{cite web|title=Prizes and Awards|url=http://www.imperial.ac.uk/mathematics/about-us/prizes-and-awards/|publisher=Imperial College London Department of Mathematics|accessdate=26 May 2019}}</ref> He retired in 2011 and remains principal teaching fellow in dynamics at Imperial.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.imperial.ac.uk/people/f.berkshire|title=Dr Frank Berkshire|publisher=Faculty of Natural Sciences, Department of Mathematics, Imperial College London|accessdate=26 May 2019}}</ref>

==Textbook==
In 1997, Berkshire became a co-author on the 4th edition of [[Tom Kibble]]'s textbook ''[[Classical Mechanics (Kibble and Berkshire book)|Classical Mechanics]]''.<ref name=isenberg>{{cite journal|last=Isenberg|first=C.|date=March 1997|doi=10.1088/0143-0807/18/2/017|issue=2|journal=[[European Journal of Physics]]|title=Review of ''Classical Mechanics'', 4th ed.|volume=18|s2cid=250869052 }}</ref>
The fifth edition was published by the [[Imperial College Press]] in 2004.<ref name=solomon>{{cite journal|last=Solomon|first=Allan I.|date=November 2012|doi=10.1080/00107514.2012.739661|issue=6|journal=[[Contemporary Physics]]|pages=542–543|title=Review of ''Classical Mechanics'', 5th ed.|volume=53|s2cid=120514537}}</ref>
